column3: States the same exchange of guidance for misguidance and names it an unprofitable trade.
Sets patient endurance within reliance and prayer, contrasting the astonished endurance toward fire.
Shows buying misguidance and seeking that others lose the way.
Frames a ruinous exchange and its unrelieved punishment, parallel to 2:175's two exchanges.
Cosmic signs do not add a focused element to the exchange, forgiveness, or fire in 2:175.
Shows attempted misguidance returning upon those who pursue it.
Defines disbelief bought for faith as a self-burdening exchange joined to painful punishment.
Its correction concerning the slain does not clarify 2:175's moral exchange.
Contrasts guidance and misguidance while exposing those who think themselves guided.
Presents guidance with truth as the opposed orientation to the misguidance bought in 2:175.
Provides the constructive setting of patience, sharpening the force of endurance toward fire.
Makes patience in the fire futile and ties it to recompense for deeds.
Presents guidance with truth as the opposed orientation to the misguidance bought in 2:175.

Pairs abiding in misguidance with the eventual sight of promised punishment.

Shows misguidance sustained through misplaced patience and exposed by punishment.

Shows repentance, repair, and clarification as the reversal of the preceding concealment.
Shows seeking forgiveness as a condition that withholds punishment.
Contrasts a call toward fire with a call toward forgiveness, showing divergent attachments.
Continues the nearby portrait of persistent disbelief under an encompassing curse.
Adds only the gathering of enemies toward fire, without the exchange or guidance contrast.
Sets guidance and misguidance as divergent responses to the summons to worship.
Repeats unrelieved punishment, strengthening the irreversible consequence of the bad exchange.

Names punishment and warning but adds no specific relation to the two exchanges.
Pairs guidance with the final outcome and denies success to wrongdoers.

The instruction to turn away has no focused contribution here.
Records denial of punishment but supplies little beyond the contested outcome.
Directs patience toward the Lord, contrasting patience imagined toward fire.

Links turning away from remembrance to an ascending punishment.
Connects patience with what is better and with forgiveness and mercy.

Depicts fire as a condition from which no self-help succeeds.
Turns former denial into compelled acknowledgment and tasting of punishment.

Links setting up rivals, leading away from the path, and the final journey to fire.
